items.headline: What Week 12's unexpected results mean for Rivalry Week and beyond

items.headline: No Big Ten football teams in AP top 5 for first time since 2021
items.description: A weekend of Big Ten upsets left the conference without a team in the top five of the AP Top 25 college football poll for the first time since 2021.

items.description: We are tracking the odds for making the CFP, earning a bye and winning it all.

items.headline: Nebraska's jab at Ohio State's 'THE' leads top Week 12 CFB trolls
items.description: Nebraska deployed a simple but effective troll that poked fun at its opponent's propensity to emphasize the "the" in "The Ohio State University."

items.headline: Betting buzz: Big Ten's odds of national champion four-peat getting slim
items.description: Losses by UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State make the Big Ten's chances of winning the national championship this season a long shot.
